summary: Blackstone Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting a routine private placement of Class I common shares, a regular monthly dividend declaration, and monthly NAV disclosure. The unregistered sale of 4,280,725 shares for $103.6 million was made under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg S, not a tender offer or capital return event. The dividend and NAV figures are standard recurring disclosures for a BDC. No special-situation event or corporate action is present.
